#!/usr/bin/env python3
# MoE/MoA async orchestrator (1s tick) for Chronos.

from __future__ import annotations
import os, json, time, pathlib, subprocess, re
from chronos_paths import identify_repo, make_paths, ensure_dirs, make_agent_id
from chronos_repo_manifest import update_repo_manifest
from chronos_event_frame import FrameCtx, Emitter
from chronos_lock import file_lock, LockBusy
from chronos_hub_registry import touch as hub_touch

def atomic_write_json(p: pathlib.Path, data: dict) -> None:
    tmp = p.with_suffix(p.suffix + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    tmp.replace(p)

def load_json(p: pathlib.Path, default: dict) -> dict:
    if p.exists():
        try:
            return json.loads(p.read_text())
        except Exception:
            return default
    return default

def ensure_tmux_session(name: str, window: str) -> None:
    subprocess.run(["bash","-lc", f'tmux has-session -t "{name}" 2>/dev/null || tmux new-session -d -s "{name}" -n "{window}"'], check=False)

def send_tmux(session: str, line: str) -> None:
    # Send C-c twice to clear any stalled handlers, then the command.
    subprocess.run(["bash","-lc", f'tmux send-keys -t "{session}" C-c C-c'], check=False)
    time.sleep(0.1)
    subprocess.run(["bash","-lc", f'tmux send-keys -t "{session}" {json.dumps(line)} C-m'], check=False)

def expert_payload() -> str:
    # Runs inside tmux. Writes three files A/B/C to outbox. Must be fast and workspace-limited.
    return r'''python3 - <<'PY'
import os, pathlib, subprocess, json
out=pathlib.Path(os.environ["OUTBOX_DIR"])
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
cycle=int(os.environ["CYCLE"])
role=os.environ["ROLE"]
root=os.environ["REPO_ROOT"]
chronos_base=os.environ["CHRONOS_BASE"]

def sh(cmd):
    r=subprocess.run(["bash","-lc",cmd], cwd=root, text=True, capture_output=True)
    return (r.stdout or "") + (("\n"+r.stderr) if r.stderr else "")

def write(tag, body):
    (out / f"cycle_{cycle}_{role}_{tag}.md").write_text(body)

if role=="EXHUMER":
    subprocess.run(["bash","-lc", f'python3 "{chronos_base}/exhumation_worker.py" --out "/tmp/exhumed_state.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true'], cwd=root)
    tmp=pathlib.Path("/tmp/exhumed_state.json")
    ghosts=[]
    if tmp.exists():
        try:
            ex=json.loads(tmp.read_text())
            ghosts=ex.get("ghosts",[])
        except Exception:
            ghosts=[]
    hot=ghosts[:30]
    write("A","EXHUMER/A\nTop entropy hotspots:\n" + "\n".join([f"- {g.get('path','')} e={g.get('entropy',0)}" for g in hot]))
    write("B","EXHUMER/B\nDirectory prefix clusters:\n" + "\n".join(sorted({(g.get('path','').split('/')[0] if g.get('path','') else '') for g in hot})))
    write("C","EXHUMER/C\nLeverage: entrypoints + config + subprocess surfaces. Next: propose 3 targets against highest entropy.")
elif role=="CARTOGRAPHER":
    top=sh("ls -1 | head -n 80")
    deps=sh("ls -1 | rg -n '(package.json|pyproject.toml|Cargo.toml|go.mod|pom.xml|requirements.txt)' || true")
    mains=sh("rg -n 'if __name__ == .__main__.' -S . || true")
    write("A",f"CARTOGRAPHER/A\nRepo root: {root}\nTop-level:\n{top}")
    write("B",f"CARTOGRAPHER/B\nDependency markers:\n{deps}")
    write("C",f"CARTOGRAPHER/C\nEntrypoints:\n{mains}")
elif role=="OPERATOR":
    ps=sh("ps -eo pid,cmd --sort=-%mem | head -n 25")
    ss=sh("ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | head -n 60 || true")
    env=sh("env | rg -n '(CHRONOS|AGENT|HB_|SESSION|PORT|REPO_)' || true")
    write("A","OPERATOR/A\nProcess snapshot:\n"+ps)
    write("B","OPERATOR/B\nListeners:\n"+ss)
    write("C","OPERATOR/C\nEnv contract:\n"+env)
elif role=="SURGEON":
    write("A","SURGEON/A\nMutation Cluster: Explode ghost surface → sidecars + explicit contracts + tests. Goal: turn entropy into typed boundaries.")
    write("B","SURGEON/B\nMutation Cluster: Parallelize repo brain → repo-local taskgraph + tmux panes per task. Goal: emergence by concurrency.")
    write("C","SURGEON/C\nMutation Cluster: Router-first refactor → add routing layer that selects handlers by pattern. Goal: explicit expert routing in code.")
elif role=="MILDLYAWESOME":
    # Emergent Recovery: Call mildlyawesome_audit with auto-discovery
    subprocess.run(["bash","-lc", f'python3 "{chronos_base}/mildlyawesome_audit.py" --repo "{root}" --vectors "DISCORD_TOKEN|Credits" "ezstreet|Legacy" --stage "/tmp/mildlyawesome_stage" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true'], cwd=root)
    stage=pathlib.Path("/tmp/mildlyawesome_stage")
    discoveries=[]
    if stage.exists():
        for p in stage.glob("**/*"):
            if p.is_file(): discoveries.append(str(p.relative_to(stage)))
    write("A","MILDLYAWESOME/A\nDeep Recovery Vectors: " + ", ".join(discoveries[:10]))
    write("B","MILDLYAWESOME/B\nPotential " + str(len(discoveries)) + " lost segments exhumed to /tmp/mildlyawesome_stage.")
    write("C","MILDLYAWESOME/C\nStrategy: Cross-reference recovered blobs with current entropy map to reconstruct lost interfaces.")
elif role=="SYNTH":
    build_rc = subprocess.run(["bash","-lc", "npm run build -- --help >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm run build >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0"], cwd=root).returncode
    write("A",f"SYNTH/A\nBuild Integrity: {'PASSED' if build_rc==0 else 'FAILED'}")
    write("B","SYNTH/B\nRouter scoring: concreteness + buildability + entropy. SURGEON takes priority on build failure.")
    write("C","SYNTH/C\nAggregation policy: favor MILDLYAWESOME when ENTROPY > 5.0.")
else:
    write("A",f"{role}/A\nnoop"); write("B",f"{role}/B\nnoop"); write("C",f"{role}/C\nnoop")
print("DONE", role, cycle)
PY'''

def route_and_aggregate(outbox: pathlib.Path, cycle: int) -> str:
    docs = sorted(outbox.glob(f"cycle_{cycle}_*.md"))
    items=[]
    for p in docs:
        txt=p.read_text(errors="replace")
        m=re.search(rf"cycle_{cycle}_(.+)_[ABC]\.md", p.name)
        role=m.group(1) if m else "UNK"
        score=0
        score += len(re.findall(r"\b(cluster|mutation|entrypoint|ports|entropy|state|tmux|lock|atomic)\b", txt, re.I))
        score += min(15, len(re.findall(r"(/|\.\w+|\bpython3\b|\brg\b|\btmux\b)", txt)))
        if p.name.endswith("_A.md"): score += 5
        elif p.name.endswith("_B.md"): score += 2
        else: score += 1
        if "FAILED" in txt: score += 10 # Prioritize failure reports
        if role == "MILDLYAWESOME": score += 3 # Baseline boost for emergence
        items.append((score, role, p.name, txt))
    items.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)
    topk = items[:6]
    for _, role, _, txt in topk:
        if role == "SURGEON":
            return txt
    parts=[t[3] for t in topk[:2]]
    return "AGGREGATE_CLUSTER\n\n" + "\n\n---\n\n".join(parts)

def main() -> int:
    ident = identify_repo(os.getcwd())
    paths = make_paths(ident)
    ensure_dirs(paths)
    agent_id = make_agent_id(ident.repo_hash)
    # Detect dependencies for Hub awareness (e.g. from package.json)
    deps = []
    pkg_json = pathlib.Path(ident.repo_root) / "package.json"
    if pkg_json.exists():
        try:
            data = json.loads(pkg_json.read_text())
            deps = list(data.get("dependencies", {}).keys()) + list(data.get("devDependencies", {}).keys())
        except Exception: pass

    try:
        hub_touch(role="COORD", status="ACTIVE", repo_root=ident.repo_root, dependencies=deps)
    except Exception:
        pass

    # emitter always available
    ctx0 = FrameCtx(repo_hash=ident.repo_hash, agent_id=agent_id, role="COORD", cycle=0, step=0,
                    run_id=f"moe_{ident.repo_hash}_{agent_id}_{int(time.time())}")
    em0 = Emitter(ctx0)

    # repo manifest (best-effort; internally locked)
    try:
        update_repo_manifest(ident.repo_root)
    except Exception:
        pass

    sp = pathlib.Path(paths.repo_state)

    # Acquire repo lock briefly to bump cycle
    try:
        with file_lock(paths.repo_lock):
            s = load_json(sp, {})
            cycle = int(s.get("cycle", 0)) + 1
            s["v"] = 1
            s["cycle"] = cycle
            s["ts"] = int(time.time())
            s["repo"] = {"root": ident.repo_root, "name": ident.repo_name, "slug": ident.repo_slug, "hash": ident.repo_hash}
            s.setdefault("actions", [])
            s.setdefault("blocked", [])
            s.setdefault("next", [])
            s.setdefault("router", {})
            s.setdefault("aggregate", {})
            s.setdefault("agents", {})
            s["agents"][agent_id] = {"id": agent_id, "last_seen": int(time.time()), "status": "DRIVER"}
            atomic_write_json(sp, s)
    except LockBusy:
        em0.emit("DIRECTIVE", {
            "intent": "LOCK_BUSY",
            "repo_lock": paths.repo_lock,
            "repo_state": paths.repo_state,
            "after_seconds": 1,
            "why": "repo lock held by another driver; contribute via inbox/outbox instead of colliding"
        })
        return 0

    # Now free lock; launch tmux experts async
    sess_coord = f"chronos_{ident.repo_hash}_coord"
    roles = ["EXHUMER","SURGEON","CARTOGRAPHER","OPERATOR","SYNTH","MILDLYAWESOME"]
    ensure_tmux_session(sess_coord, "coord")
    for role in roles:
        ensure_tmux_session(f"chronos_{ident.repo_hash}_{role}", role)

    ctx = FrameCtx(repo_hash=ident.repo_hash, agent_id=agent_id, role="COORD", cycle=cycle, step=0,
                   run_id=f"moe_{ident.repo_hash}_{agent_id}_{int(time.time())}")
    em = Emitter(ctx)
    em.emit("STATE", {"repo_state": paths.repo_state, "repo_manifest": paths.repo_manifest, "outbox": paths.outbox_dir})

    payload = expert_payload()
    expert_script = pathlib.Path(ident.repo_root) / "state" / "chronos_expert_payload.py"
    expert_script.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    expert_script.write_text(payload.replace("python3 - <<'PY'\n", "").rstrip("\nPY"))

    for role in roles:
        sess = f"chronos_{ident.repo_hash}_{role}"
        prefix = (
            f'export REPO_ROOT={json.dumps(ident.repo_root)} '
            f'CHRONOS_BASE={json.dumps(paths.chronos_base)} '
            f'OUTBOX_DIR={json.dumps(paths.outbox_dir)} '
            f'ROLE={json.dumps(role)} '
            f'CYCLE={cycle}; '
        )
        send_tmux(sess, prefix + f"python3 {expert_script}")

    # Adaptive wait loop (up to 15s) for heavy experts (MILDLYAWESOME/SYNTH)
    outbox = pathlib.Path(paths.outbox_dir)
    for _ in range(15):
        time.sleep(1)
        found = list(outbox.glob(f"cycle_{cycle}_*.md"))
        if len(found) >= len(roles) * 2: # At least 2 files per role (A/B/C)
             break

    agg = route_and_aggregate(outbox, cycle)
    agg_path = outbox / f"cycle_{cycle}_AGGREGATE.md"
    agg_path.write_text(agg)

    # Lock again to record aggregate (and abort if cycle advanced)
    try:
        with file_lock(paths.repo_lock):
            s = load_json(sp, {})
            if int(s.get("cycle", 0)) != cycle:
                em.emit("DIRECTIVE", {"intent":"STALE_CYCLE","expected":cycle,"actual":int(s.get("cycle",0)),"after_seconds":1})
                return 0
            s["router"] = {"cycle": cycle, "outbox_count": len(list(outbox.glob(f"cycle_{cycle}_*.md")))}
            s["aggregate"] = {"path": str(agg_path), "preview": agg[:600]}
            s["next"] = [{
                "cycle": cycle,
                "kind": "MUTATION_CLUSTER",
                "payload_path": str(agg_path),
                "intent": "MODEL_APPLY_CLUSTER"
            }]
            s.setdefault("agents", {})
            s["agents"][agent_id] = {"id": agent_id, "last_seen": int(time.time()), "status": "DRIVER"}
            atomic_write_json(sp, s)
    except LockBusy:
        em.emit("DIRECTIVE", {"intent":"LOCK_BUSY_POST","repo_lock":paths.repo_lock,"after_seconds":1})
        return 0

    em.emit("DIRECTIVE", {
        "intent": "APPLY_CLUSTER",
        "payload_path": str(agg_path),
        "repo_state": str(sp),
        "after_seconds": 1,
        "why": "MoE cycle produced next mutation cluster; apply exactly one cluster, prove, checkpoint, then rerun orchestrator."
    })
    
    # 10x LENS_UPDATE: Bridge to UI
    hub_state = load_json(pathlib.Path(paths.registry), {})
    em.emit("LENS_UPDATE", {
        "cycle": cycle,
        "aggregate": agg[:2000],
        "hub": {
            "repos_tracked": len(hub_state.get("repos", {})),
            "agents_active": len(hub_state.get("agents", {}))
        },
        "integrity": "PASSED" if "Build Integrity: PASSED" in agg else "DEGRADED"
    })

    em.emit("DIRECTIVE", {"intent":"CALL_BACK","after_seconds":1,"why":"continue async loop; experts may still be writing late outputs"})
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

        const chars = '01アイウエオカキクケコサシスセソタチツテト';
        const fontSize = 14;
        const columns = canvas.width / fontSize;
        const drops = Array(Math.floor(columns)).fill(1);

            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
            ctx.font = fontSize + 'px monospace';
            for (let i = 0; i < drops.length; i++) {
                const text = chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length)];
                ctx.fillText(text, i * fontSize, drops[i] * fontSize);
                if (drops[i] * fontSize > canvas.height && Math.random() > 0.975) drops[i] = 0;
                drops[i]++;
            }

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Per-repo manifest writer (repo-hash keyed)

from __future__ import annotations
import json, time, pathlib
from typing import Dict, Any
from chronos_paths import identify_repo, make_paths, ensure_dirs, make_agent_id
from chronos_lock import file_lock
from chronos_hub_registry import touch as hub_touch

def load_json(p: pathlib.Path, default: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if p.exists():
        try:
            return json.loads(p.read_text())
        except Exception:
            return default
    return default

def atomic_write(p: pathlib.Path, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    tmp = p.with_suffix(p.suffix + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    tmp.replace(p)

def update_repo_manifest(repo_root: str | None = None) -> str:
    ident = identify_repo(repo_root)
    paths = make_paths(ident)
    ensure_dirs(paths)
    try:
        hub_touch(role="MANIFEST", status="ACTIVE", repo_root=ident.repo_root)
    except Exception:
        pass

    mp = pathlib.Path(paths.repo_manifest)
    m = load_json(mp, {"v": 1, "repo": {}, "paths": {}, "sessions": {}, "agents": {}, "ts": 0})

    agent_id = make_agent_id(ident.repo_hash)
    now = int(time.time())

    m["v"] = 1
    m["ts"] = now
    m["repo"] = {"root": ident.repo_root, "name": ident.repo_name, "slug": ident.repo_slug, "hash": ident.repo_hash}
    m["paths"] = {
        "repo_dir": paths.repo_dir,
        "repo_state": paths.repo_state,
        "inbox": paths.inbox_dir,
        "outbox": paths.outbox_dir,
        "legacy_state_file": paths.legacy_state_file,
    }
    m["sessions"] = {
        "coord": f"chronos_{ident.repo_hash}_coord",
        "exhumer": f"chronos_{ident.repo_hash}_EXHUMER",
        "surgeon": f"chronos_{ident.repo_hash}_SURGEON",
        "cartographer": f"chronos_{ident.repo_hash}_CARTOGRAPHER",
        "operator": f"chronos_{ident.repo_hash}_OPERATOR",
        "synth": f"chronos_{ident.repo_hash}_SYNTH",
    }
    m.setdefault("agents", {})
    m["agents"][agent_id] = {"id": agent_id, "last_seen": now, "status": "ACTIVE"}

    with file_lock(paths.repo_lock):
        atomic_write(mp, m)
    return str(mp)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(update_repo_manifest())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# JSONL event framing + artifact persistence for CortexStep-style loops

from __future__ import annotations
import sys, json, time, gzip, base64, hashlib, pathlib
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Tuple

def _sha256(b: bytes) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()

def _now() -> int:
    return int(time.time())

def _gzip_chunks(b: bytes, chunk_size: int = 48_000) -> Tuple[int, List[str]]:
    gz = gzip.compress(b, compresslevel=6)
    parts = [gz[i:i+chunk_size] for i in range(0, len(gz), chunk_size)]
    return len(gz), [base64.b64encode(p).decode("ascii") for p in parts]

@dataclass
class FrameCtx:
    repo_hash: str
    agent_id: str
    role: str
    cycle: int
    step: int
    run_id: str

class Emitter:
    def __init__(self, ctx: FrameCtx):
        self.ctx = ctx
        self._line = 0

    def _prefix(self) -> str:
        self._line += 1
        return f"[CHR|{self.ctx.repo_hash}|{self.ctx.agent_id}|{self.ctx.role}|{self.ctx.cycle}|{self.ctx.step}|L{self._line:06d}]"

    def emit(self, type_: str, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        env = {
            "v": 1,
            "ts": _now(),
            "run_id": self.ctx.run_id,
            "repo_hash": self.ctx.repo_hash,
            "agent_id": self.ctx.agent_id,
            "role": self.ctx.role,
            "cycle": self.ctx.cycle,
            "step": self.ctx.step,
            "type": type_,
            "payload": payload,
        }
        sys.stdout.write(self._prefix() + " " + json.dumps(env, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
        sys.stdout.flush()

def write_artifacts(state_dir: str, run_id: str, step: int, stdout_b: bytes, stderr_b: bytes) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    base = pathlib.Path(state_dir) / "artifacts" / run_id
    base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    outp = base / f"{step:04d}.stdout.log"
    errp = base / f"{step:04d}.stderr.log"
    outp.write_bytes(stdout_b)
    errp.write_bytes(stderr_b)
    return {
        "stdout_ref": str(outp),
        "stderr_ref": str(errp),
        "stdout_len": len(stdout_b),
        "stderr_len": len(stderr_b),
        "stdout_sha256": _sha256(stdout_b),
        "stderr_sha256": _sha256(stderr_b),
    }

def maybe_emit_chunks(em: Emitter, stream: str, ref_path: str, b: bytes, threshold: int = 8192) -> None:
    if len(b) <= threshold:
        return
    gz_len, chunks = _gzip_chunks(b)
    em.emit("OUTPUT_CHUNKS", {
        "stream": stream,
        "ref": ref_path,
        "gzip": True,
        "gzip_len": gz_len,
        "chunk_count": len(chunks),
        "chunks_b64": chunks,
    })

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Chronos path + identity resolution utilities (repo-hash keyed)

from __future__ import annotations
import os, re, hashlib, pathlib, socket, time
from dataclasses import dataclass

def _sha1_12(s: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha1(s.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12]

def resolve_repo_root(cwd: str | None = None) -> str:
    cwd = cwd or os.getcwd()
    p = pathlib.Path(cwd).resolve()
    cur = p
    while True:
        if (cur / ".git").exists():
            return str(cur)
        if cur.parent == cur:
            return str(p)
        cur = cur.parent

def slugify(name: str) -> str:
    name = name.lower()
    name = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9._-]+", "-", name)
    name = re.sub(r"-{2,}", "-", name).strip("-")
    return name or "repo"

def resolve_chronos_base() -> str:
    env = os.environ.get("CHRONOS_BASE")
    if env:
        return str(pathlib.Path(env).resolve())
    here = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve()
    return str(here.parent)

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RepoIdentity:
    repo_root: str
    repo_name: str
    repo_slug: str
    repo_hash: str

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ChronosPaths:
    chronos_base: str
    state_dir: str
    hub_dir: str
    registry: str
    hub_lock: str
    repo_dir: str
    repo_lock: str
    repo_state: str
    repo_manifest: str
    inbox_dir: str
    outbox_dir: str
    legacy_state_file: str

def identify_repo(cwd: str | None = None) -> RepoIdentity:
    root = resolve_repo_root(cwd)
    name = pathlib.Path(root).name
    slug = slugify(name)
    h = _sha1_12(root)
    return RepoIdentity(root, name, slug, h)

def make_paths(ident: RepoIdentity) -> ChronosPaths:
    base = resolve_chronos_base()
    state_dir = str(pathlib.Path(base) / ".chronos")
    hub_dir = str(pathlib.Path(state_dir) / "hub")
    repo_dir = str(pathlib.Path(state_dir) / "repos" / ident.repo_hash)
    legacy = str(pathlib.Path(state_dir) / f"{ident.repo_slug}_{ident.repo_hash}_state.json")
    return ChronosPaths(
        chronos_base=base,
        state_dir=state_dir,
        hub_dir=hub_dir,
        registry=str(pathlib.Path(hub_dir) / "registry.json"),
        hub_lock=str(pathlib.Path(hub_dir) / "hub.lock"),
        repo_dir=repo_dir,
        repo_lock=str(pathlib.Path(repo_dir) / "repo.lock"),
        repo_state=str(pathlib.Path(repo_dir) / "state.json"),
        repo_manifest=str(pathlib.Path(repo_dir) / "manifest.json"),
        inbox_dir=str(pathlib.Path(repo_dir) / "inbox"),
        outbox_dir=str(pathlib.Path(repo_dir) / "outbox"),
        legacy_state_file=legacy,
    )

def ensure_dirs(paths: ChronosPaths) -> None:
    for d in [paths.state_dir, paths.hub_dir, paths.repo_dir, paths.inbox_dir, paths.outbox_dir]:
        pathlib.Path(d).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def make_agent_id(repo_hash: str) -> str:
    host = socket.gethostname()
    pid = os.getpid()
    start = int(os.environ.get("CHRONOS_AGENT_START_TS", "0") or 0)
    if start == 0:
        start = int(time.time())
        os.environ["CHRONOS_AGENT_START_TS"] = str(start)
    seed = f"{host}:{pid}:{start}:{repo_hash}"
    return _sha1_12(seed)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Simple non-blocking file locks for multi-agent Chronos coordination.

from __future__ import annotations
import os, time
from contextlib import contextmanager

try:
    import fcntl
except Exception:  # pragma: no cover
    fcntl = None  # type: ignore

class LockBusy(RuntimeError):
    pass

@contextmanager
def file_lock(path: str, *, nonblock: bool = True):
    if fcntl is None:
        # best-effort: no lock available on platform
        yield
        return
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_CREAT | os.O_RDWR, 0o644)
    try:
        flags = fcntl.LOCK_EX | (fcntl.LOCK_NB if nonblock else 0)
        try:
            fcntl.flock(fd, flags)
        except BlockingIOError:
            raise LockBusy(path)
        yield
    finally:
        try:
            fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
        except Exception:
            pass
        os.close(fd)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Global hub registry: cross-agent awareness across repos.

from __future__ import annotations
import os, json, time, socket, pathlib
from typing import Dict, Any
from chronos_paths import identify_repo, make_paths, ensure_dirs, make_agent_id
from chronos_lock import file_lock

def load_json(p: pathlib.Path, default: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if p.exists():
        try:
            return json.loads(p.read_text())
        except Exception:
            return default
    return default

def atomic_write(p: pathlib.Path, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    tmp = p.with_suffix(p.suffix + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    tmp.replace(p)

def detect_env_keys(root: str) -> list[str]:
    keys = []
    try:
        p = pathlib.Path(root) / ".env"
        if p.exists():
            for line in p.read_text().splitlines():
                line = line.strip()
                if line and not line.startswith("#") and "=" in line:
                    k = line.split("=", 1)[0].strip()
                    keys.append(k)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return sorted(list(set(keys)))

def touch(role: str = "AGENT", status: str = "ACTIVE", repo_root: str | None = None, dependencies: list[str] | None = None) -> str:
    ident = identify_repo(repo_root)
    paths = make_paths(ident)
    ensure_dirs(paths)
    agent_id = make_agent_id(ident.repo_hash)
    host = socket.gethostname()
    now = int(time.time())

    regp = pathlib.Path(paths.registry)
    with file_lock(paths.hub_lock):
        reg = load_json(regp, {"v": 1, "ts": 0, "agents": {}, "repos": {}})
        reg["v"] = 1
        reg["ts"] = now
        reg.setdefault("agents", {})
        reg["agents"][agent_id] = {
            "id": agent_id,
            "host": host,
            "pid": os.getpid(),
            "repo_hash": ident.repo_hash,
            "repo_root": ident.repo_root,
            "role": role,
            "status": status,
            "last_seen": now,
        }
        reg.setdefault("repos", {})
        reg["repos"].setdefault(ident.repo_hash, {"hash": ident.repo_hash, "root": ident.repo_root, "agents": {}, "dependencies": [], "env_keys": []})
        
        # 20x Secret Detection
        env_keys = detect_env_keys(ident.repo_root)
        if env_keys:
             reg["repos"][ident.repo_hash]["env_keys"] = list(set(reg["repos"][ident.repo_hash].get("env_keys", []) + env_keys))

        if dependencies:
            reg["repos"][ident.repo_hash]["dependencies"] = list(set(reg["repos"][ident.repo_hash].get("dependencies", []) + dependencies))
        reg["repos"][ident.repo_hash]["agents"][agent_id] = {"role": role, "status": status, "last_seen": now}
        atomic_write(regp, reg)

    return str(regp)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    role = os.environ.get("ROLE", "AGENT")
    status = os.environ.get("STATUS", "ACTIVE")
    print(touch(role=role, status=status))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""A safe, workspace-limited exhumation worker.
Writes /tmp/exhumed_state.json with a short list of high-entropy files found under the working dir.
"""
import json
import os
import sys
import argparse
from pathlib import Path

def scan(root: Path, max_depth: int = 5, patterns=('.py', '.js', '.sh', '.md', '.c', '.h')):
    found = []
    root = root.resolve()
    for dirpath, dirs, files in os.walk(root):
        if Path(dirpath).resolve().relative_to(root).parts and len(Path(dirpath).resolve().relative_to(root).parts) > max_depth:
            dirs[:] = []
            continue
        for f in files:
            if f.endswith(patterns) or 'emergent_api' in f or 'whitesur' in f:
                p = Path(dirpath) / f
                try:
                    with open(p, 'r', errors='ignore') as fh:
                        h = fh.read(1024)
                    score = len(set(h)) / (len(h) + 1)
                    if score > 0.03:
                        found.append({'path': str(p), 'entropy': round(score, 4), 'head': h[:200]})
                except Exception as e:
                    found.append({'path': str(p), 'error': str(e)})
    return found

if __name__ == '__main__':
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Chronos exhumation worker (workspace-limited)")
    ap.add_argument("--root", default=os.getcwd(), help="root directory to scan (default: cwd)")
    ap.add_argument("--max-depth", type=int, default=6, help="max directory depth (default: 6)")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="/tmp/exhumed_state.json", help="output JSON path")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    cwd = Path(args.root)
    exhumed = scan(cwd, max_depth=args.max_depth)
    out = {'status': 'ACTIVE', 'count': len(exhumed), 'ghosts': exhumed[:200], 'root': str(cwd)}
    out_path = Path(args.out)
    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(out_path, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(out, f)
    print(f'EXHUMATION_COMPLETE: {len(exhumed)} clusters found -> {out_path}')
    sys.exit(0)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# FLUIDPRISM OP: MILDLYAWESOME_AUDIT_V5 — Python Merge (Zero-Point Edition)
# Purpose: Deep recovery of "missing" code/secrets via refs+reflogs search + fsck unreachable blob scan.
# Usage:
#   chmod +x mildlyawesome_audit.py
#   ./mildlyawesome_audit.py --repo /path/to/repo
#   ./mildlyawesome_audit.py --repo . --vector "DiscordLiveUpdates|Discord Live Ops Module" --vector "DISCORD_TOKEN|Discord Credentials"
#
# Notes:
# - Phase 2: async term searches using (a) pickaxe (-S) and (b) git grep across reachable commits + reflog-walk commits.
# - Phase 3: git fsck unreachable blob scan (batch cat-file) for terms that had no grep hits.
#
# Requirements: git installed; Python 3.10+ recommended.

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import collections
import concurrent.futures
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shlex
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple


# -----------------------------
# Color / formatting / Timing
# -----------------------------
class C:
    RED = "\033[0;31m"
    GREEN = "\033[0;32m"
    YELLOW = "\033[1;33m"
    BLUE = "\033[0;34m"
    CYAN = "\033[0;36m"
    MAGENTA = "\033[0;35m"
    GREY = "\033[0;90m"
    NC = "\033[0m"


class MildlyAwesomeClock:
    def __init__(self):
        self.epoch = time.perf_counter()
    def delta(self) -> str:
        return f"[{ (time.perf_counter() - self.epoch) * 1000 :08.2f}ms]"

CLOCK = MildlyAwesomeClock()


def colorize(s: str, col: str, use_color: bool) -> str:
    msg = f"{col}{s}{C.NC}" if use_color else s
    return f"{colorize_dim(CLOCK.delta(), use_color)} {msg}"


def colorize_dim(s: str, use_color: bool) -> str:
    return f"{C.GREY}{s}{C.NC}" if use_color else s


def resolve_tool(name: str, override: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[str]:
    """Return absolute path for tool name (optionally using override)."""
    if override:
        p = Path(override)
        if p.exists():
            return str(p)
    return shutil.which(name)


def ensure_tool(name: str, path: Optional[str], requested: bool) -> Optional[str]:
    tool = resolve_tool(name, path)
    if requested and not tool:
        print(colorize(f"⚠️  Requested tool '{name}' not found on PATH.", C.YELLOW, True))
    return tool


def short_sha(s: str) -> str:
    return s[:7] if len(s) >= 7 else s


# -----------------------------
# Data models
# -----------------------------
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Vector:
    term: str
    desc: str


@dataclass
class TermResult:
    vector: Vector
    pickaxe_lines: List[str]
    grep_hits: List[Tuple[str, str]]  # (commit, file)
    grep_raw: List[str]
    worktree_hits: List[Tuple[str, str, str]]  # (path, line, preview)


@dataclass
class BlobHit:
    term: str
    blob: str
    origin: str  # "dangling" / "unreachable" / etc


# -----------------------------
# Git helpers (async + sync)
# -----------------------------
async def run_git_async(repo: Path, args: Sequence[str], timeout_s: Optional[float] = None) -> Tuple[int, str, str]:
    """Run `git -C repo ...` asynchronously; return (rc, stdout, stderr)."""
    cmd = ["git", "-C", str(repo), *args]
    try:
        proc = await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(
            *cmd,
            stdout=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,
        )
        try:
            out_b, err_b = await asyncio.wait_for(proc.communicate(), timeout=timeout_s)
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            proc.kill()
            out_b, err_b = await proc.communicate()
            return 124, out_b.decode("utf-8", "replace"), err_b.decode("utf-8", "replace")
        return proc.returncode, out_b.decode("utf-8", "replace"), err_b.decode("utf-8", "replace")
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return 127, "", "git not found"


def run_git_sync(repo: Path, args: Sequence[str]) -> Tuple[int, str, str]:
    import subprocess

    cmd = ["git", "-C", str(repo), *args]
    try:
        p = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=False)
        return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace"), p.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace")
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return 127, "", "git not found"


def require_git_repo(repo: Path) -> Path:
    rc, out, err = run_git_sync(repo, ["rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"])
    if rc != 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"❌ Not a git repo (or git unavailable): {repo}\n{err.strip()}")
    return Path(out.strip())


def git_dir(repo: Path) -> Path:
    rc, out, err = run_git_sync(repo, ["rev-parse", "--git-dir"])
    if rc != 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"❌ Cannot resolve .git dir:\n{err.strip()}")
    gd = out.strip()
    # git returns relative path for normal repos; absolute for some setups.
    return (repo / gd).resolve() if not os.path.isabs(gd) else Path(gd).resolve()


# -----------------------------
# Phase 0: State diagnosis
# -----------------------------
def detect_rebase_state(gitdir: Path) -> Tuple[bool, Dict[str, str]]:
    info: Dict[str, str] = {}
    rebase_merge = gitdir / "rebase-merge"
    rebase_apply = gitdir / "rebase-apply"
    in_rebase = rebase_merge.is_dir() or rebase_apply.is_dir()
    if in_rebase:
        head_name = rebase_merge / "head-name"
        if head_name.exists():
            try:
                info["rebasing_branch"] = head_name.read_text(errors="replace").strip()
            except Exception:
                pass
        onto = rebase_merge / "onto"
        if onto.exists():
            try:
                info["onto"] = onto.read_text(errors="replace").strip()
            except Exception:
                pass
    return in_rebase, info


# -----------------------------
# Phase 2: GOD-EYE GREP + PICKAXE (async per term)
# -----------------------------
def build_commit_sets(repo: Path, max_commits: int) -> List[str]:
    # Reachable from refs
    rc1, out1, _ = run_git_sync(repo, ["rev-list", "--all", f"--max-count={max_commits}"])
    # Reachable from reflogs (walk-reflogs) — deeper recovery vector
    rc2, out2, _ = run_git_sync(repo, ["rev-list", "--walk-reflogs", "--all", f"--max-count={max_commits}"])

    commits: List[str] = []
    seen = set()

    for src_out in (out1, out2):
        for line in src_out.splitlines():
            h = line.strip()
            if not h:
                continue
            if h not in seen:
                commits.append(h)
                seen.add(h)

    if not commits and (rc1 != 0 or rc2 != 0):
        # still proceed; grep will just find nothing
        return []
    return commits


def chunked(seq: Sequence[str], n: int) -> List[List[str]]:
    return [list(seq[i : i + n]) for i in range(0, len(seq), n)]


def parse_grep_line(line: str) -> Optional[Tuple[str, str]]:
    # Typical: <rev>:<path>:<line>:<content>
    # Sometimes: <rev>:<path>:<content> (if -n omitted; but we always use -n)
    parts = line.split(":", 3)
    if len(parts) < 2:
        return None
    cand_rev = parts[0]
    cand_path = parts[1]
    if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]{7,40}", cand_rev):
        return cand_rev, cand_path
    return None


async def ripgrep_worktree(repo: Path, term: str, limit: int, rg_path: Optional[str], timeout_s: Optional[float]) -> List[Tuple[str, str, str]]:
    """Use ripgrep to search working tree quickly. Returns [(path, line, preview)]."""
    if not rg_path:
        return []
    # Ignore stage to prevent recursive staging loops
    cmd = [rg_path, "--color", "never", "--no-heading", "-n", "--max-count", str(limit), "-g", "!stage/*", term]
    try:
        proc = await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(
            *cmd,
            cwd=str(repo),
            stdout=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,
        )
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return []
    try:
        out_b, err_b = await asyncio.wait_for(proc.communicate(), timeout=timeout_s)
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        proc.kill()
        out_b, err_b = await proc.communicate()
    if proc.returncode not in (0, 1):
        return []
    hits: List[Tuple[str, str, str]] = []
    for line in out_b.decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines():
        if not line:
            continue
        parts = line.split(":", 2)
        if len(parts) < 2:
            continue
        path = parts[0]
        line_no = parts[1]
        preview = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else ""
        hits.append((path, line_no, preview))
    return hits[:limit]


async def pickaxe_search(repo: Path, term: str, limit: int) -> List[str]:
    # Using -S for exact-string pickaxe. (Not regex.)
    # Keep it light; user can rerun with higher limits.
    args = [
        "log",
        "--all",
        "--source",
        "--date=short",
        "-S",
        term,
        "--pretty=format:%h %ad %s (%S)",
        f"-n{limit}",
    ]
    rc, out, _ = await run_git_async(repo, args)
    if rc != 0 or not out.strip():
        return []
    return [ln.rstrip("\n") for ln in out.splitlines() if ln.strip()]


async def grep_across_commits(
    repo: Path,
    term: str,
    commits: List[str],
    hits_limit: int,
    chunk_size: int,
    timeout_s: Optional[float],
) -> Tuple[List[Tuple[str, str]], List[str]]:
    hits: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
    raw_lines: List[str] = []

    if not commits:
        return hits, raw_lines

    for chunk in chunked(commits, chunk_size):
        # git grep -F TERM <rev...> --   (no pathspec)
        args = ["grep", "-I", "-n", "-F", term, *chunk, "--"]
        rc, out, _ = await run_git_async(repo, args, timeout_s=timeout_s)
        if rc == 0 and out.strip():
            for line in out.splitlines():
                line = line.rstrip("\n")
                if not line:
                    continue
                raw_lines.append(line)
                parsed = parse_grep_line(line)
                if parsed:
                    hits.append(parsed)
                if len(hits) >= hits_limit:
                    return hits[:hits_limit], raw_lines[:hits_limit]
        # rc=1 means "no matches" for grep; that's fine.
    return hits[:hits_limit], raw_lines[:hits_limit]


async def search_term(
    repo: Path,
    vector: Vector,
    commits: List[str],
    pickaxe_limit: int,
    grep_hits_limit: int,
    grep_chunk_size: int,
    grep_timeout_s: Optional[float],
    rg_path: Optional[str],
    rg_hits_limit: int,
    rg_timeout_s: Optional[float],
) -> TermResult:
    pickaxe_lines = await pickaxe_search(repo, vector.term, pickaxe_limit)
    hits, raw = await grep_across_commits(
        repo=repo,
        term=vector.term,
        commits=commits,
        hits_limit=grep_hits_limit,
        chunk_size=grep_chunk_size,
        timeout_s=grep_timeout_s,
    )
    worktree_hits: List[Tuple[str, str, str]] = []
    if rg_path:
        worktree_hits = await ripgrep_worktree(
            repo=repo,
            term=vector.term,
            limit=rg_hits_limit,
            rg_path=rg_path,
            timeout_s=rg_timeout_s,
        )
    return TermResult(vector=vector, pickaxe_lines=pickaxe_lines, grep_hits=hits, grep_raw=raw, worktree_hits=worktree_hits)


# -----------------------------
# Phase 3: Blob hunting via fsck + cat-file --batch (single-pass, multi-term)
# -----------------------------
def parse_fsck_blobs(fsck_out: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
    """
    Return {blob_sha: origin_label} for dangling/unreachable blobs.
    Lines often look like:
      dangling blob <sha>
      unreachable blob <sha>
    """
    out: Dict[str, str] = {}
    for ln in fsck_out.splitlines():
        ln = ln.strip()
        m = re.match(r"^(dangling|unreachable)\s+blob\s+([0-9a-f]{40})\b", ln)
        if m:
            out[m.group(2)] = m.group(1)
    return out


# -----------------------------
# Additional helper features (emergent "killer features")
# -----------------------------


def llm_emit(kind: str, payload: dict, use_json: bool) -> None:
    """Emit a machine-readable LLM-focused line or a human-friendly print.

    When use_json is True this prints a single-line JSON object prefixed by
    the kind tag so downstream LLM parsers can easily locate structured output.
    """
    if use_json:
        out = {"kind": kind, "payload": payload}
        print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False))
    else:
        # minimal human readable fallback
        print(f"[{kind}] {json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)}")


def ensure_dir(p: Path) -> None:
    try:
        p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    except Exception:
        pass


def guess_extension_from_text(s: str) -> str:
    txt = s[:4096]
    if txt.startswith("%PDF-"):
        return ".pdf"
    if txt.startswith("PK\x03\x04"):
        return ".zip"
    if txt.startswith("#!"):
        # shebang - try to infer
        if "python" in txt:
            return ".py"
        return ".sh"
    if "class " in txt or "def " in txt or "import " in txt:
        return ".py"
    if "package " in txt or "public class" in txt:
        return ".java"
    if "<html" in txt or "<!DOCTYPE html" in txt.lower():
        return ".html"
    return ".txt"


def save_blob_to_stage(repo: Path, blob_sha: str, term: str, stage_root: Path, use_json: bool, original_path: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[Path]:
    """Retrieve blob content and save it under stage_root/<blob_sha>/ inferred filename.
    Also emits a [file_read] JSON line if use_json is True.
    """
    rc, out, err = run_git_sync(repo, ["show", blob_sha])
    if rc != 0:
        return None
    content_bytes = out.encode("utf-8", "surrogateescape") if isinstance(out, str) else out
    
    # if original_path provided, we prioritize its extension
    ext = ""
    if original_path:
        ext = Path(original_path).suffix

    # try decode
    try:
        text = content_bytes.decode("utf-8")
        if not ext:
            ext = guess_extension_from_text(text)
        
        safe_name = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]", "_", term)[:40] or "term"
        dest_dir = stage_root / blob_sha
        ensure_dir(dest_dir)
        
        # Structure: <stage_root>/<hash>/<reconstructed_path>
        if original_path:
            filename = Path(original_path).name
            # nesting under path structure
            rel_path = Path(original_path)
            dest_dir = stage_root / blob_sha / rel_path.parent
            ensure_dir(dest_dir)
        else:
            filename = f"recovered_{safe_name}_{blob_sha[:7]}{ext}"
            
        dest_path = dest_dir / filename
        with open(dest_path, "wb") as f:
            f.write(content_bytes)
        
        # LLM Visibility: Dump content to stdout in a delimited block
        if not use_json:
            print(colorize_dim(f"--- BEGIN_RECOVERED_CONTENT: {dest_path} ---", use_color=True))
            try:
                # print first 100 lines or 10KB
                lines = text.splitlines()
                for ln in lines[:100]:
                    print(f"| {ln}")
                if len(lines) > 100:
                    print(f"| ... (truncated {len(lines)-100} lines)")
            except Exception:
                print("| [Binary/Non-UTF8 Data]")
            print(colorize_dim(f"--- END_RECOVERED_CONTENT ---", use_color=True))

        llm_emit("file_read", {"path": str(dest_path), "blob": blob_sha, "term": term, "reconstructed": bool(original_path)}, use_json)
        return dest_path
    except Exception:
        # binary fallback
        dest_dir = stage_root / blob_sha
        ensure_dir(dest_dir)
        filename = f"recovered_{blob_sha[:7]}.bin"
        dest_path = dest_dir / filename
        with open(dest_path, "wb") as f:
            f.write(content_bytes)
        llm_emit("file_read", {"path": str(dest_path), "blob": blob_sha, "term": term, "binary": True}, use_json)
        return dest_path


def clone_repos(urls: List[str], dest_root: Path, depth: int = 1, threads: int = 4, use_json: bool = False) -> List[Path]:
    """Clone a list of repository URLs into dest_root concurrently. Returns list of local paths created.
    Uses --depth to keep clones lightweight when possible.
    """
    ensure_dir(dest_root)
    out_paths: List[Path] = []

    def _clone(url: str) -> Optional[Path]:
        name = re.sub(r"[:/.@]+", "-", url).strip("-")[:120]
        dest = dest_root / name
        if dest.exists():
            llm_emit("clone_skip", {"url": url, "path": str(dest)}, use_json)
            return dest
        rc, out, err = run_git_sync(dest_root, ["clone", "--depth", str(depth), url, str(dest)])
        llm_emit("clone_result", {"url": url, "rc": rc, "path": str(dest), "err": err.strip()}, use_json)
        if rc == 0:
            return dest
        return None

    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, threads)) as ex:
        futures = {ex.submit(_clone, u): u for u in urls}
        for fut in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):
            p = fut.result()
            if p:
                out_paths.append(p)
    return out_paths


def auto_discover_vectors(repo: Path, max_terms: int = 20, fd_path: Optional[str] = None, fd_max_depth: int = 3) -> List[Vector]:
    """Heuristic discovery of candidate search vectors from obvious project files.

    Scans README, package manifests and common filenames to propose terms when none are supplied.
    """
    candidates = collections.Counter()
    scan_files = ["README.md", "README", "package.json", "pyproject.toml", "requirements.txt", "Pipfile", "Dockerfile"]
    for fname in scan_files:
        p = repo / fname
        if p.exists():
            try:
                t = p.read_text(errors="ignore")
                # split on non-word, count tokens of length>3
                for w in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9_]{4,}", t):
                    candidates[w] += 1
            except Exception:
                continue

    # also file names via fd if available for speed
    if fd_path:
        try:
            proc = subprocess.run(
                [fd_path, "--hidden", "--type", "f", "--max-depth", str(fd_max_depth)],
                cwd=str(repo),
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                check=False,
                text=True,
            )
            for line in proc.stdout.splitlines():
                name = Path(line).name
                if len(name) > 3:
                    candidates[name] += 1
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass
    else:
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(repo):
            for f in files:
                if len(f) > 3:
                    candidates[f] += 1
            # limit scan depth a little
            break

    out: List[Vector] = []
    for term, _ in candidates.most_common(max_terms):
        out.append(Vector(term=term, desc="auto-discovered"))
    return out


def code_search_across_local_repos(repos: List[Path], term: str, max_hits: int = 20) -> List[Tuple[str, str, str]]:
    """Run a simple grep -R across provided local repos returning tuples (repo,path,line).
    """
    hits: List[Tuple[str, str, str]] = []
    for r in repos:
        rc, out, err = run_git_sync(r, ["grep", "-I", "-n", "-F", term, "--", "."])
        if rc == 0 and out:
            for ln in out.splitlines()[:max_hits]:
                # format: path:line:content
                parts = ln.split(":", 2)
                if len(parts) >= 2:
                    path = parts[0]
                    content = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else ""
                    hits.append((str(r), path, content))
    return hits


def github_pattern_vectors(
    queries: List[str],
    limit: int,
    languages: List[str],
    gh_path: Optional[str],
    use_json: bool,
) -> List[Vector]:
    if not queries or not gh_path:
        return []
    harvested: List[Vector] = []
    for query in queries:
        cmd = [gh_path, "search", "code", query, "--limit", str(limit), "--json", "name,path,repository"]
        for lang in languages:
            cmd += ["--language", lang]
        try:
            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=False, text=True)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return []
        if proc.returncode != 0:
            llm_emit("github_pattern_error", {"query": query, "stderr": proc.stderr.strip()}, use_json)
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(proc.stdout)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        for item in data:
            repo_name = item.get("repository", {}).get("name", "repo")
            name = item.get("name") or item.get("path") or "pattern"
            desc = f"github:{repo_name}:{item.get('path','')}"
            harvested.append(Vector(term=name, desc=desc))
    return harvested


def fsck_unreachable_blobs(repo: Path, mode: str, timeout_s: float = 30.0) -> Dict[str, str]:
    """
    mode: "default" | "no-reflogs" | "both"
    Returns union of blobs with origin tag; if both, origin becomes e.g. "dangling(no-reflogs)".
    """
    blobs: Dict[str, str] = {}

    def one(pass_args: List[str], tag_suffix: str) -> None:
        # Use sync run with timeout if possible or just rely on run_git_sync for now
        # Actually run_git_sync doesn't have timeout. Let's add it.
        import subprocess
        cmd = ["git", "-C", str(repo), *pass_args]
        try:
            p = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=False, timeout=timeout_s)
            parsed = parse_fsck_blobs(p.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace"))
            for h, origin in parsed.items():
                if h in blobs:
                    continue
                blobs[h] = f"{origin}{tag_suffix}"
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            print(colorize(f"⚠️  [AUDIT_TIME_GATE] fsck operation timed out after {timeout_s}s. Proceeding with partial data.", C.YELLOW, True))
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass

    base = ["fsck", "--unreachable", "--full", "--no-progress"]
    if mode == "default":
        one(base, "")
    elif mode == "no-reflogs":
        one(base + ["--no-reflogs"], "(no-reflogs)")
    elif mode == "both":
        one(base, "")
        one(base + ["--no-reflogs"], "(no-reflogs)")
    else:
        one(base, "")
    return blobs


def scan_blobs_for_terms(
    repo: Path,
    blob_ids: List[str],
    blob_origin: Dict[str, str],
    terms: List[str],
    per_term_limit: int,
    max_blob_bytes: int,
) -> List[BlobHit]:
    """
    Efficient-ish multi-term scan:
    - Only scans blob objects (from fsck list)
    - Uses `git cat-file --batch` for speed
    - Streaming read with carry to handle term split across block boundaries
    """
    import subprocess

    if not blob_ids or not terms:
        return []

    pending = {t: 0 for t in terms}  # count hits per term
    term_bytes = {t: t.encode("utf-8", "ignore") for t in terms}
    max_term_len = max((len(b) for b in term_bytes.values()), default=1)

    hits: List[BlobHit] = []

    proc = subprocess.Popen(
        ["git", "-C", str(repo), "cat-file", "--batch"],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    )
    assert proc.stdin is not None
    assert proc.stdout is not None

    # Feed all blob hashes
    for h in blob_ids:
        proc.stdin.write((h + "\n").encode("ascii", "ignore"))
    proc.stdin.flush()
    proc.stdin.close()

    # Read each object back
    for _ in blob_ids:
        header = proc.stdout.readline()
        if not header:
            break
        header_s = header.decode("utf-8", "replace").strip()
        # header: "<sha> <type> <size>"
        parts = header_s.split()
        if len(parts) < 3:
            # consume unknown; bail carefully
            continue
        sha, otype, size_s = parts[0], parts[1], parts[2]
        try:
            size = int(size_s)
        except ValueError:
            size = 0

        # consume content (and trailing newline)
        to_read = size
        carry = b""

        # Skip huge blobs quickly (still must drain from stream)
        if size > max_blob_bytes:
            # drain without scanning
            while to_read > 0:
                chunk = proc.stdout.read(min(65536, to_read))
                if not chunk:
                    break
                to_read -= len(chunk)
            proc.stdout.read(1)  # trailing newline
            continue

        # Scan in blocks
        while to_read > 0:
            chunk = proc.stdout.read(min(65536, to_read))
            if not chunk:
                break
            to_read -= len(chunk)

            window = carry + chunk
            if len(window) > max_term_len:
                carry = window[-(max_term_len - 1) :]
            else:
                carry = window

            # Check pending terms; small term count => direct "in" is fine
            for t, b in term_bytes.items():
                if pending[t] >= per_term_limit:
                    continue
                if b and (b in window):
                    pending[t] += 1
                    hits.append(BlobHit(term=t, blob=sha, origin=blob_origin.get(sha, "unknown")))
            # Fast-exit if nothing pending
            if all(pending[t] >= per_term_limit for t in pending):
                # still must drain remaining bytes for this object
                while to_read > 0:
                    drain = proc.stdout.read(min(65536, to_read))
                    if not drain:
                        break
                    to_read -= len(drain)
                break

        # trailing newline after content
        proc.stdout.read(1)

        # If all terms satisfied, we can stop early (but we must also stop reading remaining objects output).
        # Easiest: break and kill proc (output would otherwise block).
        if all(pending[t] >= per_term_limit for t in pending):
            proc.kill()
            break

    try:
        proc.wait(timeout=1)
    except Exception:
        proc.kill()

    # Only return first N hits per term (keep deterministic-ish)
    filtered: List[BlobHit] = []
    counts: Dict[str, int] = {}
    for h in hits:
        counts.setdefault(h.term, 0)
        if counts[h.term] < per_term_limit:
            filtered.append(h)
            counts[h.term] += 1
    return filtered

def parse_vectors(raw: List[str]) -> List[Vector]:
    out: List[Vector] = []
    for s in raw:
        if "|" in s:
            term, desc = s.split("|", 1)
        else:
            term, desc = s, ""
        term = term.strip()
        desc = desc.strip()
        if term:
            out.append(Vector(term=term, desc=desc or ""))
    return out


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="mildlyawesome_audit.py",
        description="MILDLYAWESOME_AUDIT_V5 (Python): refs+reflog scan + fsck unreachable blob hunting for recovery.",
        formatter_class=argparse.ArgumentDefaultsHelpFormatter,
    )
    p.add_argument("--repo", type=str, default=".", help="Repository root (or any subdir within repo).")
    p.add_argument(
        "--vector",
        action="append",
        default=[],
        help="Search vector as 'TERM|DESC' (repeatable). If omitted, uses merged defaults.",
    )

    # Phase 2 tuning
    p.add_argument("--max-commits", type=int, default=5000, help="Max commits to scan (refs + reflog-walk).")
    p.add_argument("--pickaxe-hits", type=int, default=5, help="Top pickaxe (-S) log lines per term.")
    p.add_argument("--grep-hits", type=int, default=5, help="Top git-grep hits per term.")
    p.add_argument("--grep-chunk", type=int, default=200, help="Commit chunk size per git-grep invocation.")
    p.add_argument("--grep-timeout", type=float, default=12.0, help="Timeout seconds per git-grep chunk (async).")

    # Phase 3 tuning
    p.add_argument(
        "--blob-hunt",
        choices=["off", "on"],
        default="on",
        help="Enable fsck unreachable blob hunting for terms with no grep hits.",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--fsck-mode",
        choices=["default", "no-reflogs", "both"],
        default="both",
        help="How aggressive fsck unreachable listing should be.",
    )
    p.add_argument("--blob-hits-per-term", type=int, default=1, help="Blob hits to show per term (usually 1).")
    p.add_argument("--max-blob-bytes", type=int, default=5_000_000, help="Skip scanning blobs larger than this.")
    p.add_argument("--no-color", action="store_true", help="Disable ANSI color output.")

    # Concurrency
    p.add_argument("--jobs", type=int, default=8, help="Max concurrent term tasks (async).")
    p.add_argument("--multitask-repos", action="store_true", help="Recurse find all repos in path and multitask audit them.")
    # Emergent features
    p.add_argument("--json-llm", action="store_true", help="Emit compact single-line JSON objects for LLM consumption.")
    p.add_argument("--sift-repo", action="append", default=[], help="Repository URL to 'sift' for donor patterns (repeatable). Clones locally.")
    p.add_argument("--sift-dest", type=str, default="./sift_repos", help="Destination folder to clone sift repos into.")
    p.add_argument("--clone-depth", type=int, default=1, help="Depth to use when cloning sift repos (keeps clones small).")
    p.add_argument("--auto-discover-vectors", action="store_true", help="If no vectors provided, attempt auto-discovery from project files.")
    p.add_argument("--stage-root", type=str, default="stage/originalstructure", help="Where to place staged recovered files and reconstructed structure.")
    p.add_argument("--velocity", choices=["low", "high"], default="high", help="If high, optimizes for millisecond speed by capping expensive scans.")
    # High-perf external tool integrations
    p.add_argument("--use-rg", action="store_true", help="Use ripgrep for millisecond worktree sweeps when available.")
    p.add_argument("--rg-path", type=str, default="", help="Optional explicit path to ripgrep binary.")
    p.add_argument("--rg-hits", type=int, default=5, help="Maximum ripgrep hits to capture per term.")
    p.add_argument("--rg-timeout", type=float, default=4.0, help="Timeout (seconds) for ripgrep invocations.")
    p.add_argument("--use-fd", action="store_true", help="Use fd-find for fast auto-discovery of candidate vectors.")
    p.add_argument("--fd-path", type=str, default="", help="Optional explicit path to fd/fd-find binary.")
    p.add_argument("--fd-max-depth", type=int, default=3, help="Maximum directory depth when fd enumerates filenames.")
    p.add_argument("--github-pattern", action="append", default=[], help="GitHub code search query to borrow terms from (requires gh CLI).")
    p.add_argument("--github-pattern-limit", type=int, default=5, help="Limit per GitHub code search query.")
    p.add_argument("--github-pattern-language", action="append", default=[], help="Language filters for GitHub pattern queries (repeatable).")
    p.add_argument("--gh-path", type=str, default="", help="Optional explicit path to GitHub CLI (gh).")
    return p


def print_header(repo: Path, use_color: bool) -> None:
    print(colorize(">>> [SYSTEM] INITIATING MILDLYAWESOME_AUDIT_V5_HIGH_FORENSICS", C.BLUE, use_color))
    print(colorize(f">>> [AUDIT_TARGET] {repo}", C.BLUE, use_color))
    print(colorize(">>> [VELOCITY] Optimized for millisecond-precision forensic recovery.", C.CYAN, use_color))


def print_phase0(repo: Path, use_color: bool) -> None:
    print()
    print(colorize("--- [AUDIT_PHASE_0] REPOSITORY INTEGRITY & STATE DIAGNOSIS ---", C.BLUE, use_color))
    gd = git_dir(repo)
    in_rebase, info = detect_rebase_state(gd)
    if in_rebase:
        print(colorize("🚨 [CRITICAL_STATE] REPOSITORY DETECTED IN REBASE MODE.", C.RED, use_color))
        print("    STATUS: Rebase state can obscure source files (patch queue index).")
        if "rebasing_branch" in info:
            print(f"    SOURCE_BRANCH: {colorize(info['rebasing_branch'], C.CYAN, use_color)}")
        if "onto" in info:
            print(f"    TARGET_COMMIT: {colorize(info['onto'], C.CYAN, use_color)}")
        print(f"    {colorize('RECOVERY_ADVISORY:', C.YELLOW, use_color)} Execute 'git rebase --abort' post-recovery.")
    else:
        print(colorize("✅ [AUDIT_STATUS] REPOSITORY STATE NOMINAL.", C.GREEN, use_color))


def print_term_result(res: TermResult, use_color: bool, use_json: bool = False, stage_root: Optional[Path] = None, repo: Optional[Path] = None) -> None:
    term = res.vector.term
    desc = res.vector.desc
    print()
    print(f"🔎 HUNTING: {colorize(repr(term), C.MAGENTA, use_color)} ({desc})")

    # Pickaxe
    print("    [Commit Search: pickaxe -S]")
    if res.pickaxe_lines:
        for ln in res.pickaxe_lines[:]:
            print(f"      {ln}")
    else:
        print(f"      {colorize_dim('No pickaxe hits.', use_color)}")

    # Grep hits
    print("    [Content Search: git grep across refs+reflogs]")
    if res.grep_hits:
        for commit, file in res.grep_hits:
            print(
                f"      {colorize('[FOUND]', C.GREEN, use_color)} "
                f"Commit: {colorize(short_sha(commit), C.CYAN, use_color)} | "
                f"File: {colorize(file, C.YELLOW, use_color)}"
            )
            print(f"        └-> RESTORE: git checkout {commit} -- {shlex.quote(file)}")
            print(f"        └-> VIEW:    git show {commit}:{shlex.quote(file)}")
            if use_json:
                llm_emit("grep_hit", {"commit": commit, "file": file, "term": res.vector.term}, use_json)
            
            # Auto-stage if requested
            if stage_root and repo:
                # get the blob sha for this commit:file
                rc, out, _ = run_git_sync(repo, ["rev-parse", f"{commit}:{file}"])
                if rc == 0:
                    blob_sha = out.strip()
                    saved = save_blob_to_stage(repo, blob_sha, term, stage_root, use_json, original_path=file)
                    if saved and not use_json:
                        print(f"        └-> STAGED:  {saved}")
    else:
        print(f"      {colorize_dim('No hits in standard commit history scan.', use_color)}")

    if res.worktree_hits:
        print("    [Realtime Search: ripgrep worktree hits]")
        for path, line_no, preview in res.worktree_hits:
            print(
                f"      {colorize('[WORKTREE]', C.CYAN, use_color)} "
                f"File: {colorize(path, C.YELLOW, use_color)} | Line: {line_no}"
            )
            if preview:
                print(f"        └-> CONTEXT: {preview.strip()}")
            if stage_root and repo:
                rc, out, _ = run_git_sync(repo, ["hash-object", "-w", "--", path])
                if rc == 0:
                    blob_sha = out.strip()
                    saved = save_blob_to_stage(repo, blob_sha, term, stage_root, use_json, original_path=path)
                    if saved and not use_json:
                        print(f"        └-> STAGED:  {saved}")


def find_all_repos_in_path(root: Path) -> List[Path]:
    """Recurse and find all .git directories to multitasking audit them."""
    repos = []
    # If root itself is a repo, add it
    try:
        rc, out, _ = run_git_sync(root, ["rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"])
        if rc == 0:
            repos.append(Path(out.strip()))
    except:
        pass
    
    # Simple walk for subdirectories
    for p in root.iterdir():
        if p.is_dir() and not p.name.startswith("."):
             repos.extend(find_all_repos_in_path(p))
    return list(set(repos))


async def audit_single_repo(repo: Path, args: argparse.Namespace, vectors: List[Vector], use_color: bool, use_json: bool, stage_root: Optional[Path], rg_path: Optional[str]) -> None:
    print_header(repo, use_color)
    print_phase0(repo, use_color)

    # Build commit list once
    print()
    print(colorize(f"--- [AUDIT_PHASE_2] COMPREHENSIVE REFS/REFLOG CONTENT INSPECTION ({repo.name}) ---", C.BLUE, use_color))
    print("LOG: Commencing global grep (HEAD, all local/remote refs, and reflog-walk history).")
    commits = build_commit_sets(repo, max_commits=args.max_commits)
    if not commits:
        print(colorize("⚠️  [WARNING] Unable to construct commit set; repository may be uninitialized.", C.YELLOW, use_color))

    # Async term scans with bounded concurrency
    sem = asyncio.Semaphore(max(1, int(args.jobs)))

    async def guarded_search(v: Vector) -> TermResult:
        async with sem:
            return await search_term(
                repo=repo,
                vector=v,
                commits=commits,
                pickaxe_limit=args.pickaxe_hits,
                grep_hits_limit=args.grep_hits,
                grep_chunk_size=args.grep_chunk,
                grep_timeout_s=args.grep_timeout if args.grep_timeout > 0 else None,
                rg_path=rg_path if args.use_rg else None,
                rg_hits_limit=args.rg_hits,
                rg_timeout_s=args.rg_timeout if args.rg_timeout > 0 else None,
            )

    tasks = [asyncio.create_task(guarded_search(v)) for v in vectors]
    results: List[TermResult] = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)

    # Print results in original vector order
    for res in results:
        print_term_result(res, use_color, use_json=use_json, stage_root=stage_root, repo=repo)

    # Phase 3: blob hunting for terms that had no grep hits
    if args.blob_hunt == "on":
        missing_terms = [r.vector.term for r in results if not r.grep_hits]
        if missing_terms:
            print()
            print(colorize("--- [AUDIT_PHASE_3] UNREACHABLE OBJECT RECOVERY (DEEP BLOB FORENSICS) ---", C.BLUE, use_color))
            blob_origin = fsck_unreachable_blobs(repo, mode=args.fsck_mode, timeout_s=10.0 if args.velocity == "high" else 60.0)
            blob_ids = list(blob_origin.keys())
            if blob_ids:
                blob_hits = scan_blobs_for_terms(
                    repo=repo,
                    blob_ids=blob_ids,
                    blob_origin=blob_origin,
                    terms=missing_terms,
                    per_term_limit=max(1, int(args.blob_hits_per_term)),
                    max_blob_bytes=max(1, int(args.max_blob_bytes)),
                )
                for bh in blob_hits:
                    print(f"    {colorize('[RECOVERED]', C.GREEN, use_color)} {bh.term} in {bh.blob[:8]} ({bh.origin})")
                    if stage_root:
                        save_blob_to_stage(repo, bh.blob, bh.term, stage_root, use_json, original_path=f"fsck_{bh.origin}_{bh.blob[:8]}")


async def main_async(argv: List[str]) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    use_color = not args.no_color
    use_json = bool(getattr(args, "json_llm", False))

    rg_path = resolve_tool("rg", args.rg_path or None) if args.use_rg else None
    fd_path = resolve_tool("fd", args.fd_path or None) or resolve_tool("fdfind", args.fd_path or None)
    gh_path = resolve_tool("gh", args.gh_path or None)

    repo_in = Path(args.repo).expanduser().resolve()
    target_repos = [repo_in]
    if getattr(args, "multitask_repos", False):
        target_repos = find_all_repos_in_path(repo_in)
        print(colorize(f"Detected {len(target_repos)} repositories for multitasking audit.", C.CYAN, use_color))

    # Parse vectors once as base
    vectors = parse_vectors(args.vector)
    # enrichment logic (discovery, github) - applies to FIRST repo or all?
    # Generally better to apply to all or discover per repo.
    # For now, let's discover per repo if --auto-discover is on.
    
    stage_root = Path(getattr(args, "stage_root", "stage/originalstructure")).expanduser().resolve()

    for r_path in target_repos:
        try:
            repo = require_git_repo(r_path)
        except:
            continue
            
        repo_vectors = list(vectors)
        if not repo_vectors:
            if args.auto_discover_vectors:
                repo_vectors = auto_discover_vectors(repo, max_terms=40, fd_path=fd_path)
            if not repo_vectors:
                repo_vectors = DEFAULT_VECTORS_MERGED
        
        # GitHub pattern borrowing (only once or per? lets do once if queries exist)
        if args.github_pattern and gh_path:
            gh_vectors = github_pattern_vectors(args.github_pattern, args.github_pattern_limit, args.github_pattern_language, gh_path, use_json)
            repo_vectors.extend(gh_vectors)

        await audit_single_repo(repo, args, repo_vectors, use_color, use_json, stage_root, rg_path)

    print()
    print(colorize(">>> [SYSTEM] MILDLYAWESOME_AUDIT_V5 OPERATIONS CONCLUDED.", C.BLUE, use_color))
    print(colorize("LOG: Investigative cycle complete. Review 'stage/' for potential forensic recoveries.", C.CYAN, use_color))
    return 0


def main() -> None:
    try:
        rc = asyncio.run(main_async(sys.argv[1:]))
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nInterrupted.")
        rc = 130
    raise SystemExit(rc)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
